prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1440×1000 desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT for Interview Book. Use the attached user-supplied screenshot only as style reference: warm white documentation surface, Chinese editorial title, thin dividers, restrained red numbering, blue links, and visible Chinese/English switch. Do not copy unsourced counts or IDs.

Composition C — focus on question comparison and causal sequence. A slim header has Interview Book, “问题索引 / 主题 / 岗位 / 晋升”, “中文 / EN”; under it a full-width search that supports Chinese and English. Left sidebar lists topics without counts. In the main reading column show breadcrumb and the question “资源只够做两项时，你会如何制定下一季度规划？”. Then use a vertical sequence with three large but flat sections: “考察意图” → “相关主题” → “来源与延伸”, with subtle connector and a short explanation of how the topic relates to the purpose; preserve the exact intent “了解你如何说明目标、取舍依据与暂缓项” and topics “资源分配 / 优先级 / 规划与执行”. Under that, show three related question rows in a comparison matrix, with columns “问题”, “与本题的关系”, “主要观察差异”: resource competition / same decision domain / ordering basis; disagreement with a manager / adds an authority conflict / alignment; resource reduction while goal stays / changes the constraint / adaptation. Keep all cells short and legible. The question and its reasoning are focal; comparison is secondary but genuinely useful. Consistent Starlight and Radix restraint, attractive and not hard to scan. No answers, fake facts/counts, sources, scores, slogans, decorative illustration, or browser frame.
decision: selected by delegated user choice; prioritizes causal explanation and question comparison
